interfaceChanges.description: Per-run Postgres I/O budget with batch defer semantics for CDP reconcile (#617).

mappings.criterion: Governor enforces configured flush/batch/concurrency limits independently of Partner API budget.
Defer path sets structured reason postgres_io_throttled; partition/window remains resumable.
Metrics/logs: batch_postgres_io_deferred_total{reason}, bronze flush size, silver batch size, concurrent shop count — no tokens/PII.
Unit tests: I/O cap exceeded → defer; under cap → promotion proceeds — PR-safe, no live Supabase required (mocks/fixtures OK).
Partner-only budget without I/O governor is explicitly **not** sufficient for A2 exit (negative test documented).
